app/(home)/layout.tsx.name: Home layout
app/(home)/layout.tsx.description: Wraps the landing page in Fumadocs' HomeLayout with the docs navbar header, or the AI chat layout when NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_CHAT_ENABLED is true.

app/(home)/opengraph-image.tsx.name: Home social card
app/(home)/opengraph-image.tsx.description: Emits the landing page's Open Graph image through Next's opengraph-image convention, drawn by the same renderer as the docs cards.

app/(home)/page.tsx.name: Landing page
app/(home)/page.tsx.description: Renders the hero and the section card grid, with the site-level canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card metadata.
